column2: [intro]
In this world full of madness and cries
Everyone shouts louder, reaching for the skies
But no one wants to truly listen
It’s a mess, a chaos, a confusing mission
People can't stand to disagree
They'd rather argue, yell, and plea
But I say, I don't care at all
Cause in the end, no one cares, they fall
On social media, opinions fly
Debates are fierce, emotions high
But I prefer to laugh at endless spats
Life's too short to argue like that
People can't stand to disagree
Throwing words, casting spells, you see
But I say, I don't care at all
Cause in the end, no one cares, they fall
[ solo ]
People can't stand to disagree
But I let go, no remorse in me
Cause in the end, no one cares, they fall
So let's dance, sing, and forget it all
[ outro ]
